qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Nordic commercial property market offers no defensible competitive moat. Office and logistics properties are vulnerable to cyclical oversupply, tenant churn, and rising financing costs.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing: ROIC <5% vs 12% hurdle; archetype 'None', REJECT). Nordic commercial property landlord lacking an economic moat. Peak-cycle debt-fueled acquisition of Kungsleden followed by rate shocks forced a massive SEK 10B dilutive rights issue in 2023.
qualitative.evidence: Historical GAAP ROIC tracks well below 5%, reflecting standard unlevered commercial property yields. Financial engineering and aggressive debt accumulation prior to 2022 forced an emergency SEK 10.2B rights issue in June 2023 to deleverage after interest coverage deteriorated.
